FULL TEXT:
UNIVERSITY INSTITUTE OF ENGINEERUNG AND TECHNOLOGY
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH- 160014, INDIA
Advertisement
Announcement and applications are invited for Young Faculty Research Fellowship (YFRF)-
01 under “Visvesvaraya PhD scheme for Electronics & IT- Phase II”, by Digital India
Corporation (DIC), MeitY, Govt. of India.
Salient Features and Eligibility Criteria of the PDF:
 Maximum tenure of 5 years (review-based renewal) with Research Fellowship @Rs.
20,000/Month, in addition to regular income/salary of the awardee.
 Research Contingency Grant of Rs. 5 Lakh/Year
 The applicant must be an Indian citizen and possess a PhD degree in a relevant area.
 Age of the applicant –max. 40 years as on last date of nomination submission.
 The applicant must have a regular position in CSE/ECE/IT branches of UIET and
should be engaged in research.
 The applicant should preferably be involved in providing guidance to some PhD
students under the Visvesvarya PhD Scheme/ or any other GoI Scheme.
 The applicant can not avail any other fellowship along with this award.
Further all scheme related details are also given on UIET website. Candidates are required to
fill the application form (attached) and upload online at link of Google form
https://forms.gle/E1rEVfKaDbYmczFh8
Last date of submission of application is 15th April 2024. Details are also given on the
following websites https://jobs.puchd.ac.in/list-jobs.php and
https://uiet.puchd.ac.in/?page_id=3175
